blockedSites.title: Blocked sites
blockedSites.description: Tabs on these sites are closed. "example.com" blocks the domain and all its subdomains; "example.com/path" blocks URLs whose path starts with /path. Case-insensitive; www. and the scheme are ignored. Google country domains are folded onto google.com.

allowedSubdomains.title: Allowed subdomains
allowedSubdomains.description: Exact hostnames that stay reachable even though a parent domain is in blockedSites, e.g. "docs.example.com". Also exempt from keyword rules.

allowedPaths.title: Allowed paths
allowedPaths.description: "host/path" prefixes that stay reachable on a blocked domain, e.g. "example.com/help". Also exempt from keyword rules.

keywordsAnywhere.title: Keywords matched anywhere
keywordsAnywhere.description: Whole words or phrases matched anywhere in the URL (host, path, query, fragment). A match closes the tab.

keywordsSubstring.title: Substring keywords
keywordsSubstring.description: Plain substrings matched anywhere in the URL, also inside longer words. Use only unambiguous strings. A match closes the tab.

keywordsSearch.title: Search keywords
keywordsSearch.description: Whole words or phrases matched only inside search query parameters (q, query, search, ...), and on translation hosts also in the URL fragment and all parameter values. A match closes the tab.

keywordsSoft.title: Soft-trigger keywords
keywordsSoft.description: Whole words or phrases matched inside search query parameters. A match shows a reflection overlay with a puzzle instead of closing the tab; during lockdown the tab is closed.

keywordsFuzzy.title: Typo-tolerant keywords
keywordsFuzzy.description: Like keywordsSearch, but typos and split words are tolerated as well: none up to 5 letters, 1 for 6 to 9 letters, 2 from 10 letters (spaces not counted). A match closes the tab.

fuzzyIgnoreWords.title: Words fuzzy keywords never match
fuzzyIgnoreWords.description: Real words that keywordsFuzzy must not match because they are a typo away from a keyword, e.g. "browse" for "browser".

blocklistUrls.title: Remote block lists
blocklistUrls.description: URLs of plain-text domain lists (one domain per line, or hosts-file format; # and ! start comments). Downloaded daily and cached; each domain is blocked with its subdomains.

lockdownExtraSites.title: Lockdown-only sites
lockdownExtraSites.description: Same format as blockedSites, but only blocked while a spiral lockdown is active.

translationHosts.title: Translation hosts
translationHosts.description: Hosts (and their subdomains) where keywordsSearch is also matched against the URL fragment and every query parameter. Leave unset to use the built-in list.

archiveOrgTerms.title: archive.org metadata terms
archiveOrgTerms.description: With archiveOrgCheck on, an archive.org item is closed when its title, subject, description, collection, creator or keywords contain one of these substrings.

closeIncognitoTabs.title: Close incognito tabs
closeIncognitoTabs.description: Close every private/incognito tab as soon as it opens. The extension must be allowed in incognito. Default: false.

blockExtensionsPage.title: Lock the extensions page
blockExtensionsPage.description: Replace the browser's extensions page with a locked page. Default: false.

scrubHistory.title: Remove blocked pages from history
scrubHistory.description: Delete the URL of every closed tab from browsing history. Default: true.

archiveOrgCheck.title: Check archive.org items
archiveOrgCheck.description: Close archive.org item pages that are flagged (noindex or darkened in metadata, a content warning on the page, or a match in archiveOrgTerms). Default: false.

mentionCheck.title: Close pages that name a blocked site
mentionCheck.description: Close pages whose address names a blocked site in its path, query or fragment, such as lists of similar sites, site statistics, domain marketplaces and downloaders. Checked against blockedSites, the sites added in the popup and the remote lists. Explicitly allowed destinations are exempt. Default: false.

pageCheck.title: Check page labels, titles and descriptions
pageCheck.description: Close pages that label themselves as adult content, and pages whose tab title or description matches keywordsAnywhere or keywordsSubstring. Explicitly allowed destinations are exempt. Default: false.
